title: collinear sketch lines, edge directions of offset faces, a tab across a corner, a cone replaced by a cone, a held flange, planes, curvatures and rays

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a 40 × 30 rectangle drawn as six lines (its long sides two collinear lines each): the region's edges, the region extruded 5 mm, the extrude's start cap extracted

cases.name: c002
cases.description: the same six lines' region thickened 2 mm into sheet metal: the definition sheet's edges and the part's faces

cases.name: c003

cases.name: c004
cases.description: an open box converted from a 40 × 30 × 20 block, 1 mm thick: a tab on its front wall running 5 mm past the corner, subtracted from the right wall with 0.2 mm clearance

cases.description: a cone frustum (radius 10 to 6, 20 tall): its side replaced by a coaxial cone from radius 12 at z = 0 to 4 at z = 20

cases.name: c006

cases.name: c007
cases.description: the planes of a block's upright edge, a planar spline, two parallel lines and a line with an arc

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a sphere of radius 10: its curvatures at three parameters; rays along x through it, from the origin and from outside

cases.name: c009
